description: Request reviewers on a pull request. users take a public user_… id or email and groups a grp_… id, qualified slug, or slug. reviewers take { kind, id } entries, the shape this tool returns: kind user, group, or service_account, with a user_…, grp_…, or sa_… id; a service_account must be a bot whose owner is on the repository's team, and a personal bot may not review a pull request its owner authored. Returns the reviewers this call requested, each with displayName when Origin resolves one, and handle for a user; a group reviewer is an id with no name.

groups.description: Group identifiers: public grp_… id, qualified slug, or slug

name.description: Origin repository name within that namespace

owner.description: Origin namespace (owner) slug, taken from list_namespaces or an earlier Origin result. A GitHub owner or org name is not an Origin namespace unless list_namespaces returns it.

reviewers.description: Reviewers by kind and public id, the shape this tool and pull_request_read return; a service_account is the sa_… id of a bot whose owner is on the repository's team

id.description: Public id: user_…, grp_…, or sa_…

users.description: User identifiers: public user_… id or email
